prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Pearland, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1485; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the parking lot collision you were involved in in Pearland, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please tell me in your own words what happened.

A: I was pulling out of a parking space at the shopping center. I checked my mirrors and started backing up slowly. Another vehicle was coming down the aisle, and I didn't see it until it was already close. Our bumpers made contact.

Q: Were you moving when the impact occurred?

A: Yes, I was backing out at very low speed, maybe a few miles an hour.

Q: Did you notice any injuries right after the collision?

A: My head hit the side window pretty hard when the car jolted. I felt dizzy and had a headache right away. I sat in the car for a few minutes before I got out.

Q: Have you been seen by a medical provider since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that afternoon. They said I had a concussion and told me to rest and avoid screens for a while. I've been having trouble concentrating and I get tired quickly.

Q: Are you still under a doctor's care?

A: Yes, I have a follow-up appointment with my primary care physician next week, and I'm keeping a symptom log.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the incident?

A: Only that I'm still dealing with the symptoms, and I'd like to make sure my medical bills are covered.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
